sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: WITHIN ONE BELT OF STRONGER WESTERLIES IMPACTING THE U.S...MODELS INDICATE BROAD UPPER TROUGHING WILL PERSIST ACROSS MUCH OF THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST AND ROCKIES. A STRONG MID LATITUDE PACIFIC UPPER JET IS BEGINNING TO DIG INTO THIS FEATURE...AND MAY CONTRIBUTE TO THE EVOLUTION OF ANOTHER CLOSED LOW OVER THE GREAT BASIN TOWARD THE END OF THIS PERIOD. PERHAPS OF GREATER SIGNIFICANCE TO THE CONVECTIVE FORECAST...A SERIES OF SMALLER SCALE IMPULSES CONTINUE TO EMERGE FROM THE BASE OF THE TROUGH... SOME LIFTING AROUND ITS EASTERN PERIPHERY...THROUGH THE NORTH CENTRAL PLAINS/UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...WHILE OTHERS SPLIT OFF TO THE EAST...AROUND THE NORTHERN PERIPHERY OF SUBTROPICAL RIDGING OVER THE SOUTHERN TIER STATES/NORTHERN MEXICAN PLATEAU AND GULF OF MEXICO. SEVERAL HAVE BECOME CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED AND WILL REMAIN SO AS THEY PROGRESS EASTWARD...WITH AN ADDITIONAL IMPULSE OR TWO MIGRATING EAST OF THE ROCKIES LATER TODAY AND TONIGHT. MODEST DESTABILIZATION...ASSOCIATED WITH MOISTENING UPSLOPE FLOW...IN THE PRESENCE OF SEASONABLY STRONG SHEAR PROBABLY WILL MAINTAIN A RISK FOR STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS TODAY. AND ANOTHER UPPER LOW DIGGING

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS THRU MID MS/LWR OH VALLEYS INTO THE SOUTHEAST
sections.text: UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN LARGE...AND PREDICTABILITY JUST APPEARS TO0 LOW AT THE PRESENT TIME TO CONFIDENTLY OUTLOOK ANYTHING BEYOND HIGHER END SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES. CONSIDERABLE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS ONGOING ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...AND IT STILL APPEARS POSSIBLE THAT ACTIVITY COULD CONSOLIDATE AND EXPAND WITHIN A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION ACROSS THE MISSOURI OZARKS INTO THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY BY DAYBREAK. THEREAFTER...AS THE MOIST DOWNSTREAM BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES WITH DAYTIME HEATING...POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR REGENERATION OR INTENSIFICATION ACROSS PARTS OF KENTUCKY AND TENNESSEE...BEFORE THE LARGE SCALE WIND FIELDS CONTRIBUTE TO A SOUTHWARD TURN ACROSS THE CUMBERLAND PLATEAU AND SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS. INSTABILITY AND MEAN FLOW FIELDS MAY NOT BE QUITE AS STRONG AS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP UPSTREAM...ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS/MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...BUT THE ENVIRONMENT STILL APPEARS LIKELY TO BE CONDUCIVE TO A SIGNIFICANT COLD POOL CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A SWATH OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. IT IS UNCERTAIN WHAT...IF ANY...IMPACT OUTFLOW FROM EARLY DAY CONVECTION WILL HAVE ON SUBSEQUENT CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS PARTS THE CENTRA

sections.title: KS/OK
sections.text: IT DOES APPEAR THAT A HOT/MOIST AND VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WILL DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON FROM CENTRAL KS INTO MO. ALL MODEL SOLUTIONS SHOW VARIOUS DEPICTIONS OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IN THIS AREA. THE MOST LIKELY PLACE FOR INTENSE STORMS WOULD BE OVER CENTRAL/EASTERN KS AND WESTERN MO WHERE AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OVER 4000 J/KG ARE POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL STORMS. A SUBTLE MID/UPPER LEVEL SPEED MAX CURRENTLY OVER CO/NM MAY ALSO TRACK INTO THE CENTRAL PLAINS HELPING TO INITIATE STORMS. THIS ACTIVITY MAY GROW UPSCALE THROUGH THE EVENING AND TRACK EASTWARD ACROSS MO INTO IL...THE SAME AREAS BEING AFFECTED THIS MORNING. LOCALLY VERY LARGE HAIL AND ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE ARE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: TN VALLEY
sections.text: MULTIPLE ONGOING CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER MO/IL/KY WILL LIKELY PERSIST MUCH OF THE DAY AND AFFECT PORTIONS OF KY/TN/AL/GA. GIVEN THE RATHER WELL-DEFINED COLD POOL IN A COUPLE OF THESE REMNANT MCSS...THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS OVER THIS REGION.

sections.title: CO/KS/NEB
sections.text: FARTHER WEST...UPSLOPE LOW LEVEL CONDITIONS ARE EXPECTED AGAIN TODAY ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF CO. A FEW STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE OFF THE MOUNTAINS AND INTO THE ADJACENT PLAINS. ..HART/ROGERS.. 06/18/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: WHILE THE PRIMARY UPPER TROUGH REMAINS OVER THE WRN U.S...DOWNSTREAM THE RIDGE HAS FLATTENED WITH A BAND OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW EXTENDING EWD THRU THE SCENTRAL STATES. THE PRIMARY SURFACE BOUNDARIES OF INTEREST WITH RESPECT TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS TODAY EXTEND FROM THE COLD POOL GENERATED BOUNDARIES NOW CROSSING TN VALLEY WWD ALONG MO/AR BORDER TO A LOW OVER NCENTRAL OK. ALSO A FEATURE OF INTEREST IS THE MCV THAT DEVELOPED OVERNIGHT CURRENTLY MOVING EWD ACROSS CENTRAL IL.

sections.title: TN VALLEY TO GA/SC..WRN NC
sections.text: DUEL COLD POOLS ARE DRIVING ESEWD ACROSS TN VALLEY AND WILL TAP INTO A VERY FAVORABLE WARM SECTOR. WITH THE STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MLCAPES CLIMBING TO 3000 J/KG...COUPLED WITH THE 30-40 KT OF SHEAR...SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE INCREASING INTO SHORT LINES/BOW THIS AFTERNOON. PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE DAMAGING WINDS WHICH WILL SPREAD ACROSS TN VALLEY...NRN GULF STATES INTO THE CAROLINAS. CONDITIONS NOW APPEAR FAVORABLE FOR THE THREAT OF A SEVERE SQUALL LINE TO REACH SC/GA COASTS BY THIS EVENING.

sections.title: ERN KS/MO
sections.text: THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES THAT EXTEND WWD ALONG MO/AR BORDER WILL BE LIKELY FOCUS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON AS CAP WEAKENS AND MLCAPES CLIMB AS HIGH AS 4000 J/KG. WHILE THE CINH WILL BE AN ISSUE UNTIL LATE THIS AFTERNOON...WHEN STORMS ARE ABLE TO INITIATE ALONG BOUNDARY THEY SHOULD QUICKLY BECOME SEVERE GIVEN THE POTENT THERMODYNAMICS. WITH THE LOW LEVEL JET INCREASING THIS EVENING TO 40KT SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP UPSCALE LEADING TO ONE OR MORE MCS/S AGAIN TONIGHT FROM ERN KS ACROSS MO. IN ADDITION TO VERY LARGE HAIL IN THE INITIAL STAGES OF INITIATION...DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE ON THE INCREASE...PRIMARILY AFTER 00Z WHEN THE SHEAR IMPROVES AND COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT OCCURS. POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT WIND DAMAGE COULD OCCUR THIS EVENING PARTS OF ERN KS AND MO. ..CO/KS/NEB... FARTHER WEST...UPSLOPE LOW LEVEL CONDITIONS ARE EXPECTED AGAIN TODAY ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF CO NWD ALONG SERN WY/NEB BORDER.. A FEW STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE OFF THE MOUNTAINS AND INTO THE ADJACENT PLAINS...AGAIN POSSIBLY DEVELOPING UPSCALE INTO AN MCS THIS EVENING AND MOVING EWD ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: LOWER OH VALLEY
sections.text: THE MCV MOVING EWD ACROSS IL SHOULD ENHANCE CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY THIS AFTERNOON LOWER OH VALLEY. CLOUD COVER AND WEAK BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW SHOULD PRECLUDE AN ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT...HOWEVER POCKETS OF INSTABILITY ALONG WITH THE ASCENT AND SHEAR WITH THE MCV DOES SUPPORT A LOW END SEVERE RISK THIS AFTERNOON. ..HALES/HURLBUT.. 06/18/2011

sections.title: NRN TX AND SRN OK
sections.text: APPEARS THAT STORMS WILL BE MORE NUMEROUS THAN EARLIER ANTICIPATED ALONG DRYLINE FROM CENTRAL OK SWWD INTO NRN TX...SO SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN INCREASED TO A SLIGHT RISK...REF WW 504. GIVEN LARGE RESERVOIR OF INSTABILITY...STORMS LIKELY TO CONTINUE THROUGH THE EVENING AND TRACK ENEWD THROUGH EAST CENTRAL OK/NWRN AR.

sections.title: NC/SC/NRN GA
sections.text: MESO HIGH/COLD POOL CONTINUES TO PUSH LINEAR MCS ESEWD THROUGH THE CAROLINAS...DESPITE WEAKER INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...WELL ORGANIZED SYSTEM LIKELY TO PRODUCE WIND DAMAGE THE NEXT FEW HOURS...REF WW 502...AND SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN EXTENDED EWD INTO NC. ANOTHER THUNDERSTORM LINE HAS REINTENSIFIED IN SRN MIDDLE TN INTO NRN AL...AND A VERY FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT IS IN PLACE FOR THIS DEVELOPING MCS TO MOVE SEWD THROUGH THE EVENING WITH WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL.

sections.title: ERN CO EWD INTO MO
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS HAD DEVELOPED BETWEEN DEN/GLD...LIKELY IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH SRN WY. EVEN THOUGH SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL SHIFT NEWD...EXPECT STORMS TO TRACK MORE EWD OR ESEWD INTO KS WHERE STRONGER INSTABILITY IS LOCATED. IF THESE STORMS SURVIVE INTO CENTRAL KS...THEY HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO GROW UPSCALE INTO AN INTENSE MCS AS IT ENCOUNTERS A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND 40-50 KT LOW LEVEL SHEAR. THEREFORE... HIGHER SEVERE HAIL/WIND PROBABILITIES AND SIGNIFICANT THREAT AREA HAVE BEEN EXTENDED WWD TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS POSSIBILITY. EXPERIMENTAL HRRR MODEL FOR THE PAST SEVERAL RUNS HAS BEEN CONSISTENT IN SHOWING VERY LARGE STORMS DEVELOPING IN THE OZARKS REGION BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON. SGF 19Z SOUNDING SHOWS CAPPING INVERSION ION IS WEAKENING AND CU ALONG AND AHEAD OF WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY INDICATES WHERE LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS STRONGEST. ONCE STORMS DEVELOP...A FAST EWD MOVING LINEAR MCS IS ANTICIPATED.

sections.title: IND EWD PORTIONS OF OH/KY
sections.text: WELL DEFINED MCV WAS MOVING EWD THROUGH CENTRAL IL...WITH RELATIVELY STRONG WIND FIELDS SAMPLED AROUND THIS FEATURE. AIR MASS IS NOT PARTICULARLY UNSTABLE DUE TO MORNING CONVECTION/ CLOUDS...BUT IF STORMS DEVELOP...SHEAR IS SUPPORTIVE OF A SEVERE THREAT.

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: SURFACE FRONT MOVING THROUGH AREA COMBINED WITH FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH EXIT REGION OF UPPER TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD STORMS EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. EFFECTIVE SHEAR AROUND 30 KT AND MUCAPES BETWEEN NEAR 1500 J/KG WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED STORMS WITH HAIL OR WIND DAMAGE. ..IMY.. 06/18/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1121 AM CDT SAT JUN 18 2011/

sections.title: SOUTH-CENTRAL PLAINS/OZARKS TO THE MIDDLE MS/TN VALLEYS
sections.text: ON THE NORTHERN EDGE OF WARMER AIR/STRONGER ELEVATED MIXED LAYER ALOFT...REGIONAL 00Z OBSERVED RAOBS SAMPLE A RELATIVELY HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT/UNSTABLE AIRMASS ALONG AN EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE THAT EXTENDS GENERALLY WEST-EAST ACROSS THE SOUTH-CENTRAL PLAINS TO THE OZARKS...ACCENTUATED BY 5500 J/KG MUCAPE AT SPRINGFIELD MO EARLY THIS EVENING. SCATTERED/RELATIVELY DISCRETE SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ESPECIALLY ACROSS EASTERN KS/FAR NORTHEAST OK INTO WESTERN/SOUTHERN MO AND FAR NORTHERN AR. HOWEVER...WITH AID OF A STRENGTHENING SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL JET...UPSCALE GROWTH/PERSISTENCE OF SEVERAL QUASI-LINEAR CLUSTERS IS LIKELY TO OCCUR BY LATE THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT...WITH WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE ACROSS EASTERN KS/OZARKS TO THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY/PERHAPS TN VALLEY. ACROSS OK/TX...OTHER HIGH BASED STORMS WILL PERSIST THIS EVENING NEAR/EAST OF THE DRYLINE...WITH SEVERE HAIL/WIND REMAINING POSSIBLE ON AN INCREASINGLY ISOLATED BASIS OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS.

sections.title: CAROLINAS/GA
sections.text: SEVERAL QUASI-LINEAR CLUSTERS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT THIS EVENING AS THEY SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD MAINLY ACROSS THE COASTAL CAROLINAS AND EASTERN GA.

sections.title: WEST-CENTRAL DAKOTAS
sections.text: A RELATIVELY ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE WEST-CENTRAL DAKOTAS IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY WANE/BECOME MORE MARGINAL THIS EVENING...BUT A MAINLY SEVERE HAIL THREAT WILL CONTINUE IN THE SHORT TERM. ..GUYER.. 06/19/2011
